packageRules.description: Group dev tooling into one PR; these bumps are noise individually. Not automerged: this tooling runs in CI with the repository checked out, so a compromised release is a supply-chain path, and a human approves it.
cryptography is the one runtime dependency and the security-critical one. Never automerge it; a human reads the changelog.
Hash-locked tool files. requirements/runtime.txt is excluded: it is derived from poetry.lock by scripts/compile_requirements.py, and tests/test_requirements_files.py fails until it is regenerated.

schedule: before 6am on the first day of the month
